clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the Forbes 400 list is not what you think it is.

Two men were arrested in Asia holding a Bitcoin wallet worth over 17 billion dollars. Another had over 50 billion in cash in a crypto wallet. Neither one shows up on the Forbes list.

Quoting J. Paul Getty: it is not how much money you have, it is how much money you control. Norway's sovereign wealth fund holds two trillion dollars - almost nobody outside a small circle can name who actually controls it. Same with Saudi Arabia's, 1.7 trillion.

The richest people on the planet were never meant to show up on a public list.
